remarks:
Welcome to 91 Wildwood, West Seneca! This spacious and beautifully updated single-family home offers the perfect blend of comfort, flexibility, and investment potential. Boasting approximately 1,806 square feet of living space, this move-in-ready property features 5 generously sized bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, 1 half bath, a bright living room, formal dining area, and a modern kitchen designed for both functionality and everyday convenience.
The home maintains its solid construction while benefiting from a complete recent renovation with numerous upgrades, including new R-13 insulation, fresh drywall and interior paint, new vinyl flooring throughout, a remodeled upstairs full bathroom, and a first-floor half bath. The roof is relatively new, providing added peace of mind and long-term value.
The layout is both practical and versatile. A welcoming living area flows seamlessly into the updated kitchen, which features a built-in oven and gas cooktop. The second floor offers three well-sized bedrooms, plus an additional spacious rear room that can be used as a bedroom, storage area, or flexible living space.
An upper-level area also includes a fourth bedroom and a large landing, ideal for a home office, lounge, play area, or study space.
Located in a quiet, well-connected, and family-friendly neighborhood, this property is just minutes from hospitals, parks, schools, shopping, and dining. Whether you are looking for a comfortable primary residence or a strong investment opportunity for rental income or Airbnb potential, this home offers immediate livability with excellent future possibilities.
Open House: Saturday, September 19, from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM
Open House: Sunday, September 20, from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM

Offer Review: Monday, September 21, at 5:00 PM
